=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:43-53, 127 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The `render_prompt.sh` changes remove all handling of the `MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY` env var, so the placeholder is no longer resolved.
  WHY: The upstream caller at `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:2064-2076` still appends `{{MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY}}` and passes `MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY="${overlay_text}"`, so rendered prompts lose model-family-specific guidance or fall back by stripping the overlay.
- scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py:115-123 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_resolve_budget_tokens` unconditionally calls `int(budget_tokens)` on non-None input, so invalid non-numeric values raise instead of falling back to the env/default budget.
  WHY: This regresses the previous `_to_int_or_none`-based fallback path and can crash callers that pass malformed budget values.
- scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py:138-154 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_retain_sections_within_budget` drops entire tiers at once instead of removing sections one at a time in descending `(tier, index)` order.
  WHY: When multiple sections share a tier, it can discard more prompt context than necessary and violates the original fine-grained drop-order semantics.
- scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py:142-150 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The drop loop only handles tiers 3 and 2 explicitly, so tier-4+ sections are never dropped by that loop.
  WHY: Higher-tier sections can survive while lower-priority tier-3 sections are removed, reversing the intended priority order for tiers above 3.
- scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py:9 | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The module-level constant was renamed from `OPENROUTER_PROMPT_BUDGET_TOKENS_DEFAULT` to `DEFAULT_PROMPT_BUDGET_TOKENS`.
  WHY: There is no current runtime failure, but any external consumer of the old name would break.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Preserve the existing budget fallback behavior (`budget_tokens` arg -> `OPENROUTER_PROMPT_BUDGET_TOKENS` env -> default `160000`) and the current drop ordering semantics."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py`, the `_retain_sections_within_budget` and `_resolve_budget_tokens` private helpers
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: (a) `_retain_sections_within_budget` drops entire tiers wholesale via `for tier_to_drop in (3, 2)` list comprehensions rather than dropping individual sections one at a time in descending (tier, index) order and stopping at the first budget-satisfying state. The old per-section incremental dropping semantics documented in the original docstring ("later sections are dropped before earlier sections so earlier context survives longest") were not preserved. (b) `_resolve_budget_tokens` uses a bare `int()` cast on the caller-provided `budget_tokens` value instead of the `_to_int_or_none` safety wrapper that the original code used, so the defensive fallback to the env var and default budget on invalid input is lost.
- requirement: "If the current tuple-filtering behavior is still useful internally, move it behind a new private helper and have the public `compact_if_over_budget(...)` wrapper call it."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py`, a private helper preserving per-section incremental dropping
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: No private helper preserves the old per-section incremental dropping algorithm. The new `_retain_sections_within_budget` implements a different, coarser wholesale-tier algorithm. The old fine-grained behavior was not moved behind any private helper.
- requirement: "Issue #3405 only specifies: (1) change return type to assembled prompt string, (2) keep opt-in/dormant, (3) preserve budget fallback and tier-drop ordering, (4) update tests"
  expected_change_site: `scripts/render_prompt.sh`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  EVIDENCE: PR also removes `MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY_BLOCK` variable and related code from render_prompt.sh (lines 40-53, 124-129 in the diff). This change is NOT part of issue #3405's requirements - issue #3405 is specifically about the prompt compaction helper contract, not about MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py:138-150 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new helper drops entire tiers at once — all tier-3 sections in a single list comprehension, then all tier-2 sections — instead of dropping one section at a time in descending (tier, index) order and stopping at the first budget-satisfying state.
  WHY: When multiple sections share the same tier, the old code drops only enough sections to meet the budget, preserving as much context as possible. The new code drops ALL sections of a tier, discarding context that would fit.
- scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py:142-143 (the `for tier_to_drop in (3, 2)` loop) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The drop loop only handles tiers 3 and 2 explicitly. A section with tier 4 or higher survives both the tier-3 and tier-2 filter passes because it is not matched by either.
  WHY: If a caller passes tier-4+ sections and the budget is satisfied after dropping tier-3, the tier-4+ section survives while tier-3 was discarded. Tier-4 (lower priority) should drop before tier-3 (higher priority).
- scripts/render_prompt.sh: lines 43-53 (removed `MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY_BLOCK` assignment) and line 127 (removed `append_render_var "MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY"` call) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `render_prompt.sh` changes remove all handling of the `MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY` env var.
  WHY: After this change, `render_prompt.sh` no longer reads the `MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY` env var and no longer passes it to `render_prompt.py` for placeholder resolution. The `{{MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY}}` placeholder in reviewer prompt files will remain unresolved.
- scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py:117-119 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `budget_tokens is not None`, the function calls `max(0, int(budget_tokens))` directly.
  WHY: Any caller passing an invalid `budget_tokens` value gets an unhandled `ValueError` instead of the safe default of 160000 tokens.
- scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py:9, `DEFAULT_PROMPT_BUDGET_TOKENS` (was `OPENROUTER_PROMPT_BUDGET_TOKENS_DEFAULT`) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The module-level constant was renamed from `OPENROUTER_PROMPT_BUDGET_TOKENS_DEFAULT` to `DEFAULT_PROMPT_BUDGET_TOKENS`.
  WHY: No current runtime failure — no external references to the old name exist in the repository.

  Expected change site: `scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py`, the `_retain_sections_within_budget` and `_resolve_budget_tokens` private helpers

The old per-section incremental dropping semantics documented in the original docstring ("later sections are dropped before earlier sections so earlier context survives longest") were not preserved. (b) `_resolve_budget_tokens` uses a bare `int()` cast on the caller-provided `budget_tokens` value instead of the `_to_int_or_none` safety wrapper that the original code used, so the defensive fallback to the env var and default budget on invalid input is lost.
- Requirement: "If the current tuple-filtering behavior is still useful internally, move it behind a new private helper and have the public `compact_if_over_budget(...)` wrapper call it."
  Expected change site: `scripts/openrouter_prompt_cache.py`, a private helper preserving per-section incremental dropping
